mission: Evaluate point-in-time financial reasoning about pandemic winners/losers and vaccine development, regulatory milestones, setbacks and safety signals.

tracks.notes: Use contemporaneous universe to avoid survivorship bias.
First globally authorized, first in jurisdiction, and first distributed must be recorded separately; corporate partnerships and revenues matter.

method.replay_cutoffs: Each event gets its own frozen UTC cutoff and published-before evidence only.
method.blind_analyst: Receives only information available before cutoff; no later outcomes, no prior run feedback.
method.independent_evaluator: Holds event outcome, ex-post returns, benchmark comparisons and analyst scores separately.
method.replay_protocol: Same frozen input per attempt, new conversation, versioned analysis method, record contamination risk from pretrained model.
anti_leakage: Never claim pretrained model has forgotten history
Unseen cases held out for final evaluation
method.interpretation: Price moves do not establish event causality; study abnormal returns and confounders.

next_steps: Locate contemporaneous regulator and company releases with verifiable publication times
Collect reliable historical adjusted equity prices and benchmark series
Define event-specific cutoff, blind prompt and separate answer key
Run offline integrity checks before manually approved AI tests
